description: Zero-Trust Enterprise Procurement: Generates an executive-ready Procurement & ROI Memorandum for Chief Information Security Officers (CISO), Data Protection Officers (DPO), and VP of Engineering. Compares TCO of traditional Cloud DLP ($1.5k–$4k/mo) vs PrivacyScrubber TEAMS ($99/mo flat) or Developer SDK ($299/mo flat), citing statutory frameworks (GDPR Art. 4/28, HIPAA §164.514, SOC 2 Type II, PCI DSS v4.0, NIST SP 800-53, EU AI Act Art. 50).

app_name.description: Target project, repository, or system name (e.g. 'Engineering AI Toolchain & Autonomous Agents'). Defaults to 'Internal AI IDE Toolchain & Workflows'.

developer.description: Requester name, role, or team (e.g. 'Engineering Platform Team'). Defaults to 'Engineering / AI Platform Team'.

estimated_volume.description: Projected prompt or token volume. Defaults to '50M - 500M characters/month'.

target_tier.description: Target license tier: 'teams' ($99/mo flat, for Cursor/Claude/Windsurf/IDE agents), 'sdk' ($299/mo flat, for backend microservices/RAG pipelines), or 'both'. Defaults to 'teams'.

team_size.description: Size of engineering team / seats. Defaults to 10.

name: generate_procurement_memo
